claims.title: Replica-programmed quantum operations admit an exact one-query contraction with a completely positive error term

scoped_dependencies.relation: Genesis family context only; N678 is on open PR #41 and not yet present on main. N681 uses independent quantum samples plus a routable physical channel; it does not reconstruct hidden source/effect matrices from observed probabilities or establish the N678 interface. No logical dependency, equivalence, transfer, or status promotion is asserted.

interface: Independent copies of an unknown finite-dimensional state plus one routed physical use of a channel with identified source ports; not passive probability-only access.
limits: Flagged half-diamond error <=1/n; rare conditional success can scale as 1/(n p). Separate proof/code archive unavailable and checks were not replayed.
